hypothesis: An attacker-controlled Proxy-Uri hostname longer than 256 bytes causes memcpy(addrstr, address->s, address->length) in coap_resolve_address_info() to overflow the static addrstr[256] buffer, writing 300 bytes into 256 bytes of storage.
evidence_source: ASan report: global-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 300 at coap_resolve_address_info.addrstr (src/coap_address.c), 0 bytes after global variable of size 256. Full report in artifacts/asan_c2_report.txt.
input_artifact: coap-client -m get -B 5 -P coap://127.0.0.1:5683 "coap://[300-byte hostname]/" against ASan-instrumented coap-server configured as forward proxy (-P,thisserver). Reproduction script: docker/repro_c2.sh
expected_behavior: AddressSanitizer reports global-buffer-overflow on WRITE of size 300 into coap_resolve_address_info.addrstr (256 bytes).
observed_behavior:
